title: Roy Palmer giving trombone lessons and selling him a horn
summary: Desvigne took trombone lessons from Roy Palmer, who sold him an old horn for a dollar and a half.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: You know him. Yeah, I remember Dutre. He was a very good tromboneer. Roy Palmer? Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer. We started out together, yeah. Roy Palmer was also. Oh, yeah. And I knew Roy and Trombone. Roy was the one giving me lessons on the trombone. Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer was giving me lessons. I told him I don't like the trumpet. I said, I want to play the trombone. He said, alright. I used to go to Roy's house every day. So, but the thing was, I'd be playing the trombone, you see, and the next day I got to play a job playing cornet, and then it wouldn't work together then, you see. I couldn't blow both of those instruments.
How did Roy play in those days? Was he one of the best, I guess?
I think Roy was a pretty good trombone player. Pretty good. I think he was a very good trombone player.
